subject.title: Gateway memory growth due to repeated file read errors

question: Should this be fixed by correcting the scheduled memory/heartbeat producers only, or by changing read-tool semantics so directory read attempts are handled as listings?
rationale: Current main already fixes two reported slices, but the remaining directory-read behavior crosses the agent tool contract and may affect existing model/tool expectations.

options.title: Fix producers only
options.body: Keep read strict and repair the scheduled producer paths that request memory-system/CORE.md or memory/agent-tasks as a file, with live scheduler proof.

options.title: Make read directory-aware
options.body: Define directory reads as a supported listing behavior, update docs/tests, and prove the compatibility impact is acceptable.

options.title: Diagnostics first
options.body: Use the new cron doctor advisory to collect a current failing job trace before committing to either behavior change.

recommendation.title: Fix producers only
recommendation.body: Keep read strict and repair the scheduled producer paths that request memory-system/CORE.md or memory/agent-tasks as a file, with live scheduler proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent cron diagnostics work is the closest current-main ownership signal for the remaining scheduled-failure investigation.
